lines.text: Hello, I'm Aisha, one of the physios. What are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with headaches that start at the base of my skull, they've been going on for three months now.
Any numbness or pins and needles in your face or arms?
I haven't had any numbness, I'm certain of that.
There's tingling in my left little finger now and again, though I'm not convinced it's real.
Any dizziness, double vision or trouble swallowing?
None of that, I made sure to write down everything before I came.
Let me have a look at your neck. Tuck your chin in and nod for me.
Pressing here at the top of the neck on the left brings on your headache, and the muscles are tight across both shoulders.
My best guess is that the headaches are coming from the top joints of the neck, but I could be wrong, so we'll keep an open mind.
That makes sense, I'm sitting at a desk all day.
If you get a sudden severe headache unlike any before, or weakness in an arm, go straight to A and E.
Okay. Should I keep working from home?
Yes, but get the screen up on a pile of books so you're looking straight ahead.
